why: The ring collapses to a point instead of landing on the tank's own footprint. Still converges, so the direction test passes; what changes is the READING -- a ring that shrinks past the tank and vanishes into it reads as the tank being consumed, which is closer to a death than to an arrival and defeats the arm's purpose while appearing to implement it.
killedBy: converge: an arrival gathers instead of expanding (issue #230) lands on the tank rather than passing through it
